Table without thead uses first row as implied header

```typescript title="WebAssembly"

function main() {
  const result = convert("<table><tr><td>Product</td><td>Price</td></tr><tr><td>Apple</td><td>1.00</td></tr></table>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
